Name: Kish, Son of Mahli
Summary: Son of Mahli, whose sons took the daughters of Eleazar.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:21: Son of Mahli, whose sons took the daughters of Eleazar.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Kish stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
